package domain

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func validTeacherAssistance() TeacherAssistance {
	hintLevel := 3
	return TeacherAssistance{
		EventID:          "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentID:        "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		CorrelationID:    "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		CausationID:      "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		LearningActionID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		ContextType:      LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:        "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		SupportContext:   TeacherSupportGuided,
		HintsUsed:        2,
		MaxHintLevel:     &hintLevel,
		InterventionUsed: false,
		Observations: []TeacherAssistanceObservation{
			{
				Target: LearningTargetRef{
					Type:    LearningTargetConcept,
					Key:     "go.error-wrapping",
					Version: "course-content-17",
				},
				Kind: TeacherObservationGuidedContext,
			},
			{
				Target: LearningTargetRef{
					Type:    LearningTargetConcept,
					Key:     "go.error-wrapping",
					Version: "course-content-17",
				},
				Kind: TeacherObservationHintUsed,
			},
		},
		PolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1",
		OccurredAt:    time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.FixedZone("local", 5*60*60)),
	}
}

func TestNewTeacherAssistanceNormalizesOpaqueTargets(t *testing.T) {
	input := validTeacherAssistance()
	input.Observations[0].Target.Key = "  go.error-wrapping  "

	got, err := NewTeacherAssistance(input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewTeacherAssistance returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if got.Observations[0].Target.Key != "go.error-wrapping" {
		t.Fatalf("target key = %q", got.Observations[0].Target.Key)
	}
	if got.OccurredAt.Location() != time.UTC {
		t.Fatalf("occurred_at location = %v, want UTC", got.OccurredAt.Location())
	}
}

func TestNewTeacherAssistanceRejectsMasteryClaims(t *testing.T) {
	input := validTeacherAssistance()
	input.Observations[0].Kind = "mastered"

	if _, err := NewTeacherAssistance(input); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected unsupported teacher observation to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestNewTeacherAssistanceRequiresIndependentSummaryToHaveNoHelp(t *testing.T) {
	input := validTeacherAssistance()
	input.SupportContext = TeacherSupportIndependent

	if _, err := NewTeacherAssistance(input); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected inconsistent independent assistance summary to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestNewTeacherAssistanceRequiresHintAggregate(t *testing.T) {
	input := validTeacherAssistance()
	input.MaxHintLevel = nil

	if _, err := NewTeacherAssistance(input); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected hints_used without max_hint_level to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestNewTeacherAssistanceRejectsDuplicateTargetObservation(t *testing.T) {
	input := validTeacherAssistance()
	input.Observations = append(input.Observations, input.Observations[0])

	if _, err := NewTeacherAssistance(input); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected duplicate target observation to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestNewTeacherAssistanceRequiresCompleteFactsForEveryTarget(t *testing.T) {
	input := validTeacherAssistance()
	input.Observations = append(input.Observations, TeacherAssistanceObservation{
		Target: LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces"},
		Kind:   TeacherObservationGuidedContext,
	})
	if _, err := NewTeacherAssistance(input); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected missing target hint observation to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestNewTeacherAssistanceAcceptsThreeFactsForOneHundredTargets(t *testing.T) {
	input := validTeacherAssistance()
	input.HintsUsed = 1
	input.InterventionUsed = true
	input.Observations = make([]TeacherAssistanceObservation, 0, 300)
	for index := 0; index < 100; index++ {
		target := LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: fmt.Sprintf("capability-%03d", index)}
		input.Observations = append(input.Observations,
			TeacherAssistanceObservation{Target: target, Kind: TeacherObservationGuidedContext},
			TeacherAssistanceObservation{Target: target, Kind: TeacherObservationHintUsed},
			TeacherAssistanceObservation{Target: target, Kind: TeacherObservationIntervention},
		)
	}
	got, err := NewTeacherAssistance(input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewTeacherAssistance returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if len(got.Observations) != 300 {
		t.Fatalf("observations = %d, want 300", len(got.Observations))
	}
}
